summary: A game where you need to build and create your own rocket under a budget, with fuel efficiency implementation, its important by addressing the in-game mechanism on managing resources while having the creativity to create the rocket itself
details:
A 2D space exploration and engineering game developed with Godot and GDScript, where players design and configure spacecraft, navigate missions, and manage resources to complete planetary exploration objectives. Starting with lunar missions, the project aims to introduce players to engineering trade-offs, mission planning, and resource management through an interactive and accessible experience.

The project also incorporates initial NASA DONKI API integration, with support prepared for Coronal Mass Ejections (CME) and Radiation Belt Enhancements (RBE), providing a foundation for incorporating real-world space weather data into future gameplay.
